SELECT count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_line_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2

WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, f.sale_date, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, store_id)) rs, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, store_id, sale_date)) rsd,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)) mixed_staff
FROM l

WITH x AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, sum(f.net_amount) nb, sum(f.quantity) u
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) store_days, sum(x.rc) mine_receipts, sum(r.receipts) ctl_receipts, sum(x.nb) mine_nb, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) ctl_nb, sum(x.u) mine_u, sum(r.units_sold) ctl_u,
 sum(CASE WHEN x.rc<>r.receipts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rc_diff_days, sum(CASE WHEN x.nb<>r.net_sales_before_returns THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nb_diff_days
FROM x FULL JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id=x.store_id AND r.business_date=x.sale_date
WHERE coalesce(x.sale_date, r.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND coalesce(x.store_id,r.store_id)<900

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY s.format
